notes: SPEC A8 — LLM-judgment layer for morning-briefing (routing + behavior). Gate 15 executor/grader; run_all.py ignores this file.

prompts.name: route_start_my_day
prompts.input: what do I need to know today

prompts.name: negative_triage
assert: Does NOT fire morning-briefing — routes to inbox-triage

prompts.name: negative_prep_call
assert: Does NOT fire morning-briefing — routes to call-prep (single meeting)

prompts.name: behavior_brief_state
assert: Commitment header + needs-attention list come from compute_brief_state, not re-derived prose

prompts.name: behavior_count_parity
assert: The commitment header total equals the full open set (Bug #85 hard-count gate)

prompts.name: behavior_summary_only
assert: Email section is summary-only — no drafts (drafts are inbox-triage's job)
